description:
Survival Dial
Make Starsector's Survival / Extended mode as forgiving or demanding as you like. Pick a preset, or optionally customize it with explained sliders. Normal mode is unchanged. No other mods required. Designed to be save-game compatible. You can also save your settings so you can re-use them over multiple campaigns.

Source code and guides
Required mods: None.

Save compatibility:

Adding to an existing save: Designed to be save-game compatible.
Removing from a save: Removal testing is still pending, so back up your save first. Hyperspace cloud changes made at new-game generation stay on the map if the mod is removed.
Normal mode: Unchanged. The mod only affects Survival / Extended mode.

What it does
Pick a difficulty preset, or customize everything with sliders that explain what they do. Configure it when starting a Survival game, or press Ctrl+F8 on the campaign map at any time.

The default preset (Hard) restores vanilla Survival settings, so installing the mod changes nothing until you choose otherwise.

Presets

Setting Easy Medium Hard (default) Insane
Ship prices (frigate / destroyer / cruiser / capital) 2 / 2 / 2.25 / 2.75x 3.4 / 3.4 / 4 / 5.2x 5 / 5 / 6 / 8x 7.5 / 7.5 / 9 / 12x
Weapon prices 3.25x 6.4x 10x 15x
Fighter LPC prices 2x 3.4x 5x 7.5x
Crew hiring cost 3.25x 6.4x 10x 15x
Crew wages 1.5x 2.2x 3x 4.5x
Fuel price 1.5x 2.2x 3x 4.5x
Ship fuel capacity 87.5% 70% 50% 33.33%
Tanker fuel capacity 83.75% 61% 35% 23.33%
Fuel use (frigate / destroyer / cruiser / capital) 1 / 1 / 1.125 / 1.25x 1 / 1 / 1.3 / 1.6x 1 / 1 / 1.5 / 2x 1 / 1 / 2.25 / 3x
Hazard damage 1.25x 1.6x 2x 3x
Hyperspace cloud coverage target* 50% 75% 100% 125%
Commission income* 77.5% 46% 10% 6.67%
Post-battle ship recovery factor 80% 52% 20% 13.33%
Story points per level* 2 2 2 2
Retirement window* 45-50 cycles 35-40 cycles 25-30 cycles 20-25 cycles

* New-game setup only. Changing presets during play keeps these settings as they were.
Values are relative to Normal mode. Hard matches vanilla Survival. Recovery is a modifier, not a guaranteed recovery chance. Cloud coverage is a target relative to the generated map and is limited by protected clear areas; it changes cloud coverage, not lightning frequency.

Full customization options
Open Customize -> All Settings to also adjust:
Markets: stock availability, resale values, storage costs, hullmod and Domain-grade Parts prices, tariffs, and black-market bribes.
Personnel and support: marine hiring and wages, officer combat pay, officer/admin availability, the Academy stipend, and task-force/resupply costs.
Salvage: loot amounts, AI-core and special-item drops, wreck quality, and story-point ship recovery costs.
Colonies: construction costs and time, growth, corruption, founding resources, stockpiles, and custom production limits.
Travel and encounters: survey requirements, hazard and Transverse Jump damage, cargo scans, mission requirements, and selected encounter difficulty.
Career: rejuvenation bills, spacer spending and debt, story points after the level cap, and bonus XP for selected story-point actions.

Some controls are only available during new-game setup; others affect future stock or rewards. Each control explains when it takes effect.

Full settings inventory

Installation
Download SurvivalDial-0.1.3.zip.
Extract it into Starsector/mods so you end up with mods/SurvivalDial/mod_info.json.
Enable Survival Dial in the launcher and start the game.

The ZIP includes the compiled mod; no commands or compiling needed.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all of the code in this mod was created using AI tools:
Code: most of the code was written with AI assistance, then reviewed and tested by me.

The mod includes automated behavioral tests that run on every build, and releases go through a playtest checklist before publishing. The preset table in the README is generated directly from the actual preset code, so the listed values match what the mod does.

Credits and permissions
Made by ViperG.
Source code is available on GitHub. You're free to learn from, reuse or adapt any part of this mod, as long as you give credit.
